title: 1.2.9 Audio-only (Live) mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Which example is live audio-only?
choices: A live audio stream without video or interaction
elements.correctAnswer: A live audio stream without video or interaction
elements.explanation: Audio-only contains audio without video or interaction.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Why is an agenda alone insufficient?
choices: It may omit the actual discussion and decisions
elements.correctAnswer: It may omit the actual discussion and decisions
elements.explanation: The alternative needs equivalent information from the event.

elements.title: What should be checked when callers participate?
choices: Caller audio reaches the transcription workflow
elements.correctAnswer: Caller audio reaches the transcription workflow
elements.explanation: The alternative must convey callers’ relevant contributions.
